assets.name: SceneWritingNookV1.png
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new landscape hero illustration for CircleU Today, approx 2:1. Reference 1 is character identity; reference 2 is the existing environment, which needs richer art direction. Match the supplied CircleU reference identity exactly: single curved crest, navy plump penguin, white heart-shaped face and belly, small oval dark eyes, tiny orange beak and feet, ice-blue scarf. Clean smooth softly dimensional matte editorial illustration, restrained shadows, no sketch strokes, no grain, no glossy toy look. Palette royal blue #054FC9, ink #0D1421, ice #F5FAFF, sky #47C7FF with restrained warm orange. No typography, lettering, logos, watermark or UI. Scene: a small cosy open-air writing nook on an ice island, sweeping curved snowy ridge behind it, a rounded arch framing a calm blue inlet and layered distant mountains. Pingu sits on the left third writing in an open blue journal on a small ice bench, thoughtful relaxed expression. Include restrained narrative detail: a little stack of two notebooks, a warm amber lantern tucked beside the bench, curved foreground snow and three broad water reflection bands. Sophisticated spatial depth through foreground/middle/distance, readable silhouette at phone size. Richer environment but not cluttered. Leave the rightmost third as quiet pale blue water/sky for a future real microphone control; DO NOT draw a microphone or fake button. Pale ice bottom edge. Entire scene contained, no frame, no other characters. No repeated tiny decoration.
